# ICL Soft-Garment World Model

In-Context Learning World Models for Robot Dual-Arm Manipulation of Soft Garment with Partial Observations

**2026-10-22 · Preprint · The Chinese University of Hong Kong**

**[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30988)**

A partial-point-cloud world model uses interaction context for material adaptation, supporting a separate goal-conditioned garment planner.

**Scope and qualifications**

- Predictive world model and goal-conditioned action planner are separate.
- Paper lists repeated observation/reconstruction/replanning as future work; do not present the current pipeline as demonstrated closed-loop MPC.
- Sensor model and simulator version are not disclosed.

1. [Primary manuscript and first-submission history](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30988) — Current primary manuscript reviewed; first-public date uses arXiv v1. Observations, training privileges and deployed interfaces retain their separate scopes.
